info.title: School Management System API
info.description: Production REST API for school operations with role-based access control, attendance tracking, grading engine, and financial ledger.

bearerAuth.description: JWT authorization header using the Bearer scheme or httpOnly auth_token cookie

get.description: Returns the operational health, database replica set status, and uptime of the API service.
Paginated list of students filtered by role scope: Admin views all, Teachers view assigned sections, Guardians view linked children.
Returns HTTP 200 when database connection is established; HTTP 503 otherwise.

post.description: Authenticates a user via email and password, setting an httpOnly JWT cookie.

401.description: Invalid credentials, account locked, or deactivated

429.description: Rate limit exceeded for login attempts

post.description: Clears the authentication cookie and ends the session.

get.description: Returns profile details and tenancy scope of the currently authenticated user.

post.description: Updates the authenticated user password with bcrypt hash verification.

get.description: Fetches student profile, enrollment history, and guardian details. Returns 404 if record is out of the user scope to prevent existence leaks.

404.description: Student not found or out of scope
